#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
S="{{session_name}}"; D="{{work_dir}}"
tmux has-session -t "$S" 2>/dev/null && { tmux attach -t "$S"; exit 0; }

tmux new-session -d -s "$S" -c "$D"
tmux rename-window -t "$S":0 'edit'
tmux send-keys -t "$S":0 'vim .' C-m
tmux new-window -t "$S" -n 'server' -c "$D"
tmux split-window -t "$S":1 -h -c "$D"
tmux attach -t "$S"
